package rulefixtures

import (
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for middleware_allocates_http_client_per_request: HTTP client allocated inside Gin handlers or middleware instead of being shared.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

func HTTPClientMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
	return func(c *gin.Context) {
		client := &http.Client{
			Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
		}

		resp, err := client.Get("https://api.example.com/health")
		if err != nil {
			c.AbortWithStatusJSON(502, gin.H{"error": "upstream unreachable"})
			return
		}
		defer resp.Body.Close()

		body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		c.Set("health_response", string(body))
		c.Next()
	}
}

var _ = io.Discard
